description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the second Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Burning-Tree Emissary token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary token's trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.
